title: Passaging Two Flasks of Adherent HEK293 Cells
servesOrScale: two T75 flasks split 1:6 into four
notes: warm-reagents is inferred: the text never makes warming a step, it only says to work with pre-warmed reagents, so the step borrows that sentence as its span and gates both flasks through a compound 'all'. The two flask tracks contend for the cabinet, the centrifuge and the microscope; each flask-B step that would collide is chained on the matching flask-A step rather than on its own predecessor alone.
